intents_zh: 專案 tmux 多 pane 啟動
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

S="{{session_name}}"
D="{{project_dir}}"

tmux has-session -t "$S" 2>/dev/null && { tmux attach -t "$S"; exit 0; }

tmux new-session -d -s "$S" -c "$D" -n editor
tmux send-keys -t "$S:editor" 'nvim .' C-m

tmux new-window -t "$S" -n server -c "$D"
tmux send-keys -t "$S:server" 'npm run dev' C-m

tmux new-window -t "$S" -n shell -c "$D"
tmux split-window -t "$S:shell" -h -c "$D"
tmux send-keys -t "$S:shell.0" 'git status' C-m

tmux select-window -t "$S:editor"
tmux attach -t "$S"
summary_zh: tmux 專案 session 多 window 自動建好
